english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Eighteen Great Thrones of all the Fathers
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by the oldest teaching layer — a systematic enumeration of 18 cosmic thrones (9 in the eternal realm, 9 in the material world). The substrate is remarkably intact with minimal editorial overlay. The only significant editorial intervention is in ¶17, where the ninth worldly throne is identified with Mani's own apostolic seat ('the apostle who has come to you at this time'). The devotional closure 'for ever and ever, amen' in ¶11 is the only exhortation. The editorial fatigue pattern is confirmed: institutional vocabulary only appears in the final third (¶10, ¶17). The teaching structure — numbered hierarchy mapping cosmic beings to cosmic positions and functions — is classic cosmological-correspondential substrate.
